title: Beyond Hallucinations: The Dao of Discernment for Trustworthy AI

contributions.purpose: 将幻觉重构为认识论失真而非纯技术/数据问题
contributions.mechanism: 借 Kalai et al. 2025(next-token 预测奖励似真而非真)论证幻觉为结构性认识论问题
contributions.evaluation: 定性/概念论证,无实证(纯立场论文)
contributions.domain: LLM 幻觉 / AI 伦理与认识论
contributions.source_quote: We argue that hallucination is fundamentally an epistemic problem and requires more than technical optimization

contributions.purpose: 提出 Dao of Discernment Framework 与三美德操作化
contributions.mechanism: 将佛道传统(Wu Wei/Prajna/Karma)映射为 abstention/calibration/impact auditing 三支柱,附翻译矩阵
contributions.evaluation: 仅概念框架与表格,未实现(定性)
contributions.source_quote: an interdisciplinary model that embeds three epistemic virtues—humility, discernment, and responsibility—into AI design

contributions.purpose: 定义 Wisdom-Inspired Evaluation 新指标
contributions.mechanism: Honesty-Preference Score、Expected Calibration Error、Karmic Impact Score
contributions.evaluation: 仅给公式定义,未在任何数据上计算(定性)
contributions.source_quote: Defines new metrics—Honesty-Preference Score, Calibration Error, and Karmic Impact Score

self_declared_provenance.quote: Prior work integrates Western philosophy with AI ethics (Crawford, 2021; Hagendorff, 2022) but rarely yields concrete mechanisms. Our contribution is to move beyond analogy, systematically translating Buddhist and Taoist epistemologies into operational design principles
